import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;

public class splitITup {

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        //37
        // _Hello_Vasya(and_Petya)__bye_(and_OK)
        List<Integer> parentStart = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> parentEnd = new ArrayList<>();

        Scanner scan = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scan.nextInt();
        String target = scan.next();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (target.charAt(i) == '(')
                parentStart.add(i);
            if (target.charAt(i) == ')')
                parentEnd.add(i);
        }

        int count = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < parentEnd.size(); i++) {
            String s = target.substring(parentStart.get(i) + 1, parentEnd.get(i));
            // System.out.print(s + " ");
            String[] ss = s.split("_");
            for (String f : ss) {
                // System.out.print("#" + f + "#");
                if (!f.equals("")) {
                    count++;
                }
            }
        }

        int max = 0;
        parentEnd.add(0, 0);
        parentStart.add(target.length());
        // for (int i : parentStart)
        // System.out.println(i);
        // for (int i : parentEnd)
        // System.out.println(i);

        for (int i = 0; i < parentEnd.size(); i++) {
            String s;
            if (target.charAt(parentEnd.get(i)) == ')')
                s = target.substring(parentEnd.get(i) + 1, parentStart.get(i));
            else
                s = target.substring(parentEnd.get(i), parentStart.get(i));
            String[] ss = s.split("_");
            for (String sss : ss) {
                if (sss.length() > max && !sss.contains("(") && !sss.contains(")")) {
                    max = sss.length();
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(max + " " + count);
    }
}
